pageSubtitle: A few quick steps will get your team set up. You can revisit this from Admin → Run setup wizard at any time.

org.label: Organization
org.title: Tell us about your company
org.description: These details show up in headers, exported reports, and audit logs.

users.label: Users
users.title: Invite your team
users.description: Add the people who will work in Cascadia and assign their roles. You can always add more later from Admin → Users.

ai.label: AI providers
ai.title: Connect an AI provider
ai.description: API keys power the chatbot, BOM drafting, and design engine. Keys are stored encrypted at rest. You can skip this and add keys later.

programs.label: Programs & data
programs.title: Bootstrap your data
programs.description: Create your first program, design, and part — or load a sample standard catalog so you can see the system in action.

tools.label: Tools
tools.title: Add your shop equipment
tools.description: Record the machines you build with — 3D printers, CNC mills, saws, welders, measurement gear. Their capabilities constrain what the design engine proposes. You can always add more later from Tools → Create Tool.

summary.label: Summary
summary.title: You're set up
summary.description: Everything below is editable from the admin pages or by re-running this wizard.

users.required: Email, name, and password are required
users.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters

ai.modelHelpDefault: Shows models for the selected provider key above, or the built-in list if none is set.
ai.modelFallbackNote: Fallback list — add a key above for live discovery.

programs.newProgramDesc: Programs group designs and parts into a shippable effort.
programs.newDesignDesc: Designs hold the engineering definition a program builds.
programs.newPartDesc: Seed one purchasable or manufactured item.
programs.sampleDesc: Load the bundled fastener and raw stock catalog so the design engine has a baseline to draw from. Safe to re-run.
